newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates down in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates down in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Wednesday to 4-1/2 to 6 percent, compared with Tuesday's range of between six and 8-1/8 percent, in a very liquid private sector market, bankers said.
Of the four bankers polled, only one was able to supply a one-week rate, put at a lower range of between 6 and 6-1/8 percent from seven on Tuesday.
One banker attributed the liquidity to the rejection this week of private sector banks in the Treasury bill auction.
"The rates dropped and almost all private banks were rejected," he said. "There is a lot of liquidity now and a long weekend coming up, so everyone wants to get rid of the excess."
Banks are closed on Thursday for the first day of the Islamic calendar and Friday and Saturday form the weekend.
Bankers said public sector banks had kept their minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
